method: corpus-blind controlled generator; 38 practical/natural/physical cross-domain cases

cases.knowledge_need: How meltwater caught behind an ice ridge can enter beneath wooden roof shingles as the day warms.
cases.circumstances: late winter thaw follows a clear freezing night
cases.situation: At midmorning water begins dripping into the loft above stored linen.

cases.knowledge_need: How to manage a barley pot when a cross-draft makes one side boil hard while the other barely simmers.
cases.circumstances: a wet autumn wind blows through an opened door
cases.situation: At dusk she must finish supper without burning grain at the hotter edge.

cases.knowledge_need: How dough temperature, proofing time, and a cooling oven affect a loaf made from coarse rye meal.
cases.circumstances: a cold spring rain delayed the firing wood
cases.situation: Before noon he must judge whether the risen dough can go into the oven.

cases.knowledge_need: How warm air and delayed gutting change the spoilage risk of freshwater fish kept in a basket.
cases.circumstances: a still summer morning becomes unexpectedly hot
cases.situation: She has landed a catch and must walk it to town after the boat is unloaded.

cases.knowledge_need: How frost followed by damp thaw affects turnips stored against an earth cellar wall.
cases.circumstances: early winter temperatures have crossed freezing for three days
cases.situation: At evening inspection several roots feel soft while the family needs food through the week.

cases.knowledge_need: How a sloshing shoulder yoke load changes balance on an icy slope beside a well.
cases.circumstances: dawn frost has formed after wet snow
cases.situation: He must bring two full pails home without falling or spilling drinking water.

cases.knowledge_need: How hard rubbing and rapid drying in strong sun can affect worn linen cloth.
cases.circumstances: a bright windy late-spring day follows muddy travel
cases.situation: By midday she needs to clean shirts without tearing their thinnest seams.

cases.knowledge_need: How rainwater dilution and uneven heating alter a plant-dye bath for wool yarn.
cases.circumstances: summer showers begin while the pot is already warming
cases.situation: She must decide how to protect the batch before its color takes unevenly.

cases.knowledge_need: How damp timber can split or loosen when a peg joint is fitted too tightly near a fire.
cases.circumstances: autumn rain has soaked the boards brought in that morning
cases.situation: Near sunset he must repair a stool needed for supper without creating a joint that soon fails.

cases.knowledge_need: How a loosened axe head and tired grip change the danger of splitting kindling.
cases.circumstances: cold drizzle has made the handle slick
cases.situation: Before dark she needs small dry pieces for the stove but notices the head has begun to shift.

cases.knowledge_need: How a high, uneven hay load affects a cart's stability on a rutted downhill lane.
cases.circumstances: late-summer rain has softened one wheel rut
cases.situation: He must take the last load to the barn before an evening storm arrives.

cases.knowledge_need: How cooling a sweating horse too quickly in a cold wind can affect it after a heavy pull.
cases.circumstances: a sharp autumn wind rises after rain
cases.situation: At nightfall a mare arrives hot and tired while its driver asks for a dawn departure.

cases.knowledge_need: How a cow's body posture and calf proximity signal that a person should give it more space.
cases.circumstances: early morning fog keeps the herd close together
cases.situation: She needs to move a pail through the gate without being pinned against the fence.

cases.knowledge_need: How damp bedding and poor air in a closed coop affect hens during a prolonged cold rain.
cases.circumstances: a spring downpour has lasted since yesterday
cases.situation: After breakfast he finds the litter wet and must care for birds without chilling them further.

cases.knowledge_need: How watering shallowly in hot dry weather differs from soaking roots when seedlings are newly transplanted.
cases.circumstances: three cloudless midsummer days have dried the upper soil
cases.situation: At sunset she has one filled bucket and tender cabbage plants to keep alive.

cases.knowledge_need: How standing water around young grain reveals blocked runoff and root stress after heavy rain.
cases.circumstances: a night thunderstorm filled the furrows
cases.situation: At first light he must decide where water can be led away without trampling the crop.

cases.knowledge_need: How dew, air movement, and pile depth affect cut grass being cured for winter fodder.
cases.circumstances: a clear June morning follows a humid night
cases.situation: She must choose when to turn yesterday's cut hay before clouds return.

cases.knowledge_need: How a partly broken fruit branch can tear further under weight if it is picked or pulled carelessly.
cases.circumstances: wind bent a loaded branch during an early-autumn squall
cases.situation: At noon he wants to save reachable fruit without worsening the tree's injury.

cases.knowledge_need: How wind, dry litter, and sparks from a cooking fire can turn a small clearing fire into a spreading hazard.
cases.circumstances: late-summer drought has left needles crisp underfoot
cases.situation: At midday a gust carries ash beyond the cleared fire spot.

cases.knowledge_need: How to compare exposure near isolated trees, open water, and a low timber shelter during close thunder.
cases.circumstances: dark clouds arrive rapidly on a humid afternoon
cases.situation: Workers hear thunder soon after lightning and need a safer pause from cutting.

cases.knowledge_need: How a rising wind and cross-current change safe loading and landing of a small rowboat.
cases.circumstances: an overcast spring morning turns gusty
cases.situation: He must bring two passengers and sacks across before the weather worsens.

cases.knowledge_need: How warmer shoreline ice and water movement below it make a familiar winter crossing less reliable.
cases.circumstances: late-winter sun has softened snow near reeds
cases.situation: At dawn he intends to check a line but sees dark wet patches by the bank.

cases.knowledge_need: How a muddy bottom and water pressure against legs change the safety of crossing a shallow stream alone.
cases.circumstances: upstream rain has made the water cloudy by late afternoon
cases.situation: She carries a dry bundle and must decide whether to cross before night.

cases.knowledge_need: How vegetation mats can conceal soft ground beside a bog and why a probing staff changes footing decisions.
cases.circumstances: morning mist hides shallow pools after a wet week
cases.situation: He must reach a berry patch without stepping from firm ground into deep mud.

cases.knowledge_need: How knots, sharp edges, and sudden loading affect a hemp rope used to raise a sack.
cases.circumstances: a cold rain has dampened the rope hanging by the hatch
cases.situation: Before evening he needs to lift grain while people work below.

cases.knowledge_need: How a stable fulcrum and controlled lift prevent a heavy log from rolling back toward hands or feet.
cases.circumstances: spring mud has softened the ground beneath a log
cases.situation: At midday he must move it onto supports before cutting begins.

cases.knowledge_need: How wet ground, ladder angle, and carrying a load affect a climb to a low roof.
cases.circumstances: a brief summer shower has just passed
cases.situation: In the evening he needs to replace loose thatch but the ladder feet sink slightly.

cases.knowledge_need: How moisture and accidental splashes make freshly slaked lime hazardous to skin and eyes.
cases.circumstances: a cool windy morning blows dust from an open mixing trough
cases.situation: He must prepare wall wash while keeping tools and his exposed hands safe.

cases.knowledge_need: How apparently dead charcoal embers can remain hot enough to ignite dry material after a kiln opening.
cases.circumstances: a dry evening breeze returns after a damp day
cases.situation: He must clear the work area before leaving without starting a grass fire.

cases.knowledge_need: How fuel level, wick condition, and a draft alter smoke and flame in an oil lamp.
cases.circumstances: winter darkness arrives while a window shutter will not close fully
cases.situation: She must finish a repair beside loose flax without letting the lamp become a fire risk.

cases.knowledge_need: How smoke collecting in a low room can affect breathing and alertness when ventilation is poor.
cases.circumstances: wet wood smolders during a freezing evening
cases.situation: He notices headache and stinging eyes while others prepare to sleep near the hearth.

cases.knowledge_need: How to recognize when wet numb feet after snow travel need more than continued walking to warm them.
cases.circumstances: a February wind followed a boot-breaking step into slush
cases.situation: At dusk she reaches a hut and must judge how urgently to dry and warm herself.

cases.knowledge_need: How thirst, dizziness, and reduced coordination can signal unsafe heat strain during heavy work.
cases.circumstances: a windless July afternoon follows little food and water
cases.situation: He feels unsteady while carrying wet clay and must not collapse near the excavation.

cases.knowledge_need: How dirt, a continuing bleed, and loss of grip affect the safe handling of a fresh knife cut.
cases.circumstances: a cold rainy morning has made the work surface muddy
cases.situation: She cuts her palm while trimming meat and still has tools and food to manage.

cases.knowledge_need: How to leave an agitated nest area and monitor a sting without provoking more insects.
cases.circumstances: a warm late-summer noon disturbed wasps in a fallen trunk
cases.situation: He has been stung and must get his companion safely away before collecting the bundle.

cases.knowledge_need: How seasonal growth stage and look-alike leaves make unfamiliar wild greens unsafe to collect casually.
cases.circumstances: new spring shoots emerge among old dead stems after rain
cases.situation: Before supper she wants greens but must avoid bringing an uncertain plant home.

cases.knowledge_need: How decay, weather, and uncertainty of identification affect whether a forest mushroom is fit to gather.
cases.circumstances: warm wet autumn weather has brought many different fungi
cases.situation: At late morning he finds pale mushrooms beside familiar kinds and must decide what belongs in the basket.

cases.knowledge_need: How wet soil, residual plant sap, and overnight damp make an iron sickle rust and work poorly.
cases.circumstances: an evening shower ends the day's cutting early
cases.situation: Before leaving she must decide how to set aside the sickle so it remains usable at dawn.
